title: To-Be-Read Pile and Book Cost-Per-Read
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:progress event=inventory
| stats sum(eval(if(status="unread",1,0))) as unread, sum(eval(if(status="unread",price,0))) as unread_value
| eval note="the pile of shame"
description: Totals your unread books and what they cost — the affectionately named pile of shame.
value: Quantifying the unread pile curbs buying more before finishing what you own, saving money and shelf space.
implementation: Ingest book inventory into `index=personal`; total unread count and value.
visualization: Single-value tiles of unread books and their value.
grandmaExplanation: It totals the books you own but have not read and what they cost, the famous pile of shame.
